card.name: The "sub" in subcutaneous
card.fires_on: The piece "sub" right before "cutaneous" in the route of administration, after words like administered, injected or inserted. Also fires on a split-off "AC" in the capitalized word EXTRACELLULAR.

modes.label: Subcutaneous route
modes.description: The "sub" that begins "subcutaneously" or "subcutaneous" in dosing directions.
modes.example: 2. DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION The recommended dosage of LEROCHOL is 300 mg administered<< sub>>cutaneously once monthly.

modes.label: Capitalized extracellular
modes.description: A partway piece of the all-caps word EXTRACELLULAR in a physiology sentence.
modes.example: FOR EVERY 3 SODIUMS INSIDE THE CELL IS EXCHANGED FOR 2 POTASSIUM IN EXTR<<AC>>
